title.simpleText: How NASA's Parker Solar Probe Survives the Sun's Atmosphere #shorts

description.simpleText:
NASA's Parker Solar Probe plunges directly into the Sun's corona, coming closer to our star than any human-made object in history. Discover how advanced carbon-composite heat shields and secret magnetic patterns protect this historic space mission from millions of degrees of extreme thermal environments.

Learn how solar wind acceleration data helps scientists understand space weather and protect Earth's power grids and satellite networks from solar disruptions.

Could we ever harness energy directly from a star's corona?
